Name: Water Whip
Description: You extend a whip of water, which lashes out at a target within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. If the attack hits, the creature takes 2d12 bludgeoning damage, and if the creature is Large or smaller, you can push or pull the creature up to 15 feet in a direction of your choice other than upwards. If the target is pulled to within 5 feet of you, you can use a bonus action to attempt to grapple it.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d12, and the distance the target is moved increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 1st (to a maximum of 30 feet).
